text.p: Cable News Network said Thursday it reorganized its top ranks, naming executive vice president Ed Turner, one of CNN's original executives, to the post of editor-at-large.
Three other executive vice presidents were given additional responsibilities.

Bob Furnad, senior executive producer, will be responsible for special events; Gail Evans, currently responsible for bookings and programming, will also take on Washington-based talk shows; Eason Jordan, presently executive vice president for international news, will also oversee domestic newsgathering.
Turner, who has been with the network since before its premiere in 1980 and was EVP in charge of newsgathering, will work on special projects for CNN News Group chairman Tom Johnson.
CNN is a unit of Time Warner Inc.
